mode: Independent read-only design/implementation audit plus real browser regression and byte preservation checks

reviewedBoundaries.detail: Synchronous pure candidate validation receives detached JSON and a captured source SHA. Workflow owns per-domain lifecycle through explicit ports and contains no DOM, HTTP, execution backend or ordinary Save authority. Browser adapter binds transport, catalog and each existing renderer; build parent only provides current source owner and navigation context.

Override and single canvas share the established instance candidate rule while retaining separate workflow functions/epochs/receipts. Batch, fragment, placement and structure use their fixed distinct strategies. No shared child form state or global approval bus was added; capability context exposes only the current entry capability and six existing source-owner fields.

The five existing accepted domains retain their envelope and target policies. Structure accepts removed openers and source-only unused targets[] while verifying complete ordered actor/group provenance; placement matches real sceneStructure.groups; final source SHA/path, draft baseline, composition identity and preview lease are bound before acceptance. Candidate validation grants no source write or executable scene authority.

Model/source/catalog/proposals are detached at ownership boundaries before asynchronous use; accessors/serializers, malformed non-JSON data and late caller/submitted DTO mutations reject. Open/reset generations and independent review/apply epochs invalidate older responses. All returned valid preview IDs are best-effort released even for stale or malformed responses.

The trusted ordinary source port still recomputes exact domain patches and guards the editor baseline. Successful memory application may advance its source token; completion retains the original parent/source/session, current apply epoch, detached proposal fingerprint and exact result identity. Sibling workflows, closed sessions and older overlapping apply responses cannot replay that receipt.

Existing editable/source-mode, request-busy/running and selected recipe/session rules remain supplied by the parent port. This extraction adds no execution-time author permissions, source disk Save, asset import/export, generated-engine reverse editing or new metadata transaction.

Six renderers, 14 Rust sources, existing shared WASM/build metadata, backend generators/runtime files and protected old scene domains retain their bytes. Browser snapshots add explicit new workflow/candidate/adapter hashes that old smoke scripts do not capture themselves. Represented editor review, cancel, ordinary Save, source conflicts, image ownership and stable UUID flows all passed.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial normal-object capability table allowed constructor/toString/__proto__ lookups to reach inherited values and throw an unclassified TypeError.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Workflow owner added string and own-key checks before capability lookup, retaining the established invalid errorCode.

reviewSuggestionsImplemented: Latest-request epochs protect overlapping reviews and applies without sharing form state.
Reset/open expire prior child owners; complete model is snapshotted before source/catalog awaits.
Exact committed receipt tolerates the source-token increment but rejects owner replacement.

retainedInitialEvidence.reason: 337 old tests initially had only the obsolete same-function reference assertion fail (336 pass, one fail, zero skip). The approved independent-function contract change retains both full POST validation and preview DELETE release; original evidence was not overwritten.
